profile.title: Synthetic receptor detection to one-hop collector communication

validity.physiological_state: abstract local communication without spatial propagation
validity.description: Checks causal M5 threshold-event translation, explicit one-hop delivery, and communication-only latency, loss, corruption, byte, and energy metrics.

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M5.1 analytical receptor-ligand software contract
sources.role: source detection response and checked threshold time

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M6.2 local communication software contract
sources.role: synthetic adapter, link, outcomes, metrics, and acceptance rules

limitations: The link latency, energy, and repeating outcomes are synthetic deterministic verification values.
The scheduled link is not a molecular, radio, optical, acoustic, or anatomical propagation model.
Loss and corruption are prescribed outcomes rather than calibrated probabilities.
The reference ends at a local collector and does not include a relay, gateway, BAN, or external station.
